question: Which famous ruler was known as the "Second Ashoka"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanishka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kanishka**:-

 
 
• Kanishka was the most well-known and greatest king among all the Kushana kings.
 
• Kanishka founded the Saka era (78 AD).
 
• **He was known as the "Second Ashoka".**
 
• Kanishka was a follower of Mahayana Buddhism.
 
• The fourth Buddhist Council was held during Kanishka's reign.
 
• Mathura and Gandhara's school of art flourished during his reign.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chandragupta II

 
 
• One of the most powerful emperors of the Gupta dynasty was Chandragupta II, also known by his given name Vikramaditya and Chandragupta Vikramaditya.
 
• He was the third ruler of the Gupta Empire in India.
 
• The famous Chandragupta II was the child of Samudragupta and Datta Devi.

• **Rudradaman I:-**
 
 
• **He belonged to the Western Kshatrapa dynasty of Kardamkas.**
 
• Rudradaman took up the title of Maha-Kshtrapa ("Great Satrap") after he became the king and then strengthened his kingdom.
 
• He later married a Hindu woman and converted into Hinduism.
